articles.title: Unicharm (TSE:8113) Stock May Be 35% Below Fair Value On Cash Flow
articles.summary: Unicharm shares have climbed in the short term, yet the longer performance record has been weak enough to make investors ask whether the current price is really supported by the cash the business can generate. With a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) view available, the key issue is how that intrinsic value estimate stacks up against where the stock trades today.
